_comment: Authoritative site data. The nudge UI (Step 9) is for finding these numbers on site;
once found, bake them in HERE. adjustments.json on the device is a per-user refinement
on top of this baseline, not where the real value lives — it is one wipe away from gone.
Coordinates to 6+ decimal places, from Google Earth Pro or a survey, not a phone GPS.
headingDeg is the TRUE-north azimuth of the model's front, 0-360 clockwise.
In footprint mode headingDeg is DERIVED from the two corners and this value is a record
of what that derivation produced, not an input.

buildings.name: Synagogue

_comment: These two points run FRONT TO BACK, not along a wall — A is on the facade and B
is the back corner (as marked in Google Earth). So the measured distance is the
building's DEPTH, and the front faces back down the line from B towards A.

_headingNote: 321.95 = bearing(A->B) 141.95 + 180. The facade looks north-west, away from the back
corner. Scale comes from the same pair: fit the model's DEPTH (Z) to 41.19 m, which
means BuildingLoader's footprintAxis must be Z, not X.
